A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same research work, with 40 readable pages including Appendices A–G. Pages 2–40 have identical text and rendered appearance; page 1 is identical outside the arXiv version/date stamp.

before.justification: v4 reports original classification experiments in Section 4 and VAE, detection, segmentation, synthetic-test, and scaling results in Appendices A–D.

after.justification: v5 retains the same original empirical results in Section 4 and Appendices A–D, including the numerical outcomes in Tables 1–4.

M1.justification: The synthesis, depth-based and BagNet classification, frequency-filtering, and distributional-analysis procedures in Sections 3–4 are identical.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same ImageNet subset for classification and retain the same detection, segmentation, and synthetic-test scenarios in the appendices.

E2.justification: The generator, VAE, and real-data comparison sets are unchanged within every corresponding experiment, including Tables 1–4.

E3.justification: The dataset splits, preprocessing, metrics, classifier configurations, training budgets, and appendix evaluation protocols are identical.

E4.justification: Both retain the same texture/structure, frequency, prompt, and distribution analyses, plus VAE reconstruction, synthetic-test performance, scaling experiments, and qualitative examples.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is identical throughout both PDFs. No run counts, seed information, uncertainty estimates, or significance-testing procedures are added or revised.

E6.justification: All numerical results, plotted trends, and qualitative findings are unchanged. For example, Table 4 retains real-test classification accuracies of 45.5 for SD1.5 and 9.9 for Qwen in both versions.

T1.justification: The mathematical descriptions and assumptions in Section 3 are identical; no definitions, derivations, theorems, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain identical claims about newer T2I models' training-data utility, texture and frequency deficiencies, and distributional realism.

C2.justification: The interpretations in Sections 4–5 and limitations in Section 6 are unchanged, including distribution collapse, captioning tradeoffs, and applicability beyond the evaluated data and models.

D1.justification: Generation settings, training details, prompt templates, SAM3 labeling, and implementation references are unchanged. The updated arXiv self-link only identifies the later document version.

R1.justification: Section 2, the bibliography, and statements positioning the study relative to prior research are identical.

P1.justification: The first-page arXiv stamp changes from v4 dated 20 Apr 2026 to v5 dated 16 Jul 2026. The title, authors, prose, terminology, and section structure remain identical.

P2.justification: The vertical arXiv stamp on page 1 shifts position. Figures 1–7, Tables 1–8, and all main-text and appendix layouts otherwise remain identical.

improvement.justification: The only differences are the first-page arXiv version/date stamp, its placement, and its self-link. The scientific content, evidence, explanations, reproducibility information, and appendices are identical, establishing no meaningful overall quality difference.
